verses.text: A poem of David. Keep me safe, God, because I come to you for safety.
I said to the LORD, "You are my Lord. Without you I have nothing good."
God's holy people in the land are wonderful. They are the ones I take delight in.
Those who run after other gods will have more and more sorrow. I will not pour out their offerings of blood, or even speak the names of their gods.
LORD, you have given me my share and my cup of blessing. You keep what is mine safe.
The land you have given me is in a pleasant place. Yes, I have a wonderful inheritance.
I will praise the LORD, who guides me. Even at night my heart teaches me.
I always keep the LORD in front of me. Because he is at my right side, nothing will shake me.
So my heart is glad, and my tongue celebrates. My body also will rest safely.
You will not leave me in the grave. You will not let your holy one rot away.
You will show me the path of life. Being with you fills me with joy. At your right hand there are pleasures that last forever.
